title: RTX 5060 Ti vs RTX 5070 vs 5070 Ti | DLSS 4 + Ray/Path Tracing | Gaming Test | 1080p, 1440p, 4K
description:
RTX 5060 Ti vs RTX 5070 vs RTX 5070 Ti — In this ultimate GPU showdown, we test all three cards across 1080p, 1440p, and 4K resolutions with Ray Tracing, Path Tracing, DLSS 4, and Multi Frame Generation enabled.
Whether you're upgrading or building a new PC, this benchmark comparison will help you choose the best graphics card for your needs!
